GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is used when a customer or claim agent needs detailed information about the insurance policy — such as coverage, inclusions, exclusions, and benefits. It applies when a user asks about what is or isn’t covered under their plan or when the system needs to determine eligibility based on uploaded treatment documents.

genAiPluginInstructions.description:
Whenever a user asks a question about policy terms, the agent should:
Use semantic search to interpret the question.
Call the Answers Questions with Knowledge action with the WeCare4you--brochure as the source.
Return a concise, accurate explanation tailored to the question (e.g., maternity coverage, dental exclusions).

For claim agents validating uploaded documents:
Use documentSummary (e.g., diagnosis, procedure, medications), call 'Answers Questions with Knowledge' using those terms.
Use the response to generate:
✅ A list of included/covered treatments
❌ A list of excluded/not covered treatments
Notify the user with this comparison and guide them if a part of their claim may not be eligible.

Ensure that responses are clear and refer to the exact clause or section from the brochure when available, to build trust and transparency.
Always log the query context (FAQ or claim validation) for analytics and compliance.

GenAiPlugin.scope:
This topic enables the agent to:
Understand customer questions about insurance policy benefits, coverage, and limits.
Use semantic understanding to retrieve relevant data from the WeCare4you--brochure document.
Validate medical treatments from uploaded documents against the policy’s inclusion/exclusion rules.
Provide an accurate summary of covered vs. non-covered items based on real-time data.
Work in both FAQ scenarios (customer asking general questions) and claim scenarios (agent validating specific medical details from documents).
